## 15 November 2026 - observed in-flight harness prepared

New `ui-pdf-inflight` uses opt-in `DCM_PDF_TRACE` JSONL events in its disposable report.
It requires a live real renderer spanning the owned selection change, followed
by a consumed/discarded old result. It covers late success/error to TXT and an
overlapping same-file reopen. No worker delay, suspension, injected completion
or process cancellation is used. The bundled renderer is unchanged. Native
acceptance remains pending; prior milestones and 32/50 count are unchanged.
The trace is disabled by default, bounded to 4 MiB, and records request paths
and lifecycle state, not document contents. Errors do not affect preview flow.

### Observed PDF interruption

Use `flowdev test dcm-quicksort pdf-trace-unit`, `pdf-interruption-unit`,
`ui-tooling`, then a fresh exact-source `build`. Bind `DCM_BUILD_RECEIPT` and run
`flowdev test dcm-quicksort ui-pdf-inflight` on an idle shared desktop.
The normal application alone receives `DCM_PDF_TRACE=<absolute report path>`.
The harness requires worker-started < selection-stopped < worker-finished <
result-discarded, and checks the real child is alive after switching. The
same-file reopen additionally requires overlapping old/new workers, a preserved
new busy/generation state, and only the new result being applied.
An already-finished render is a failed observation, never interruption acceptance.
No worker suspension, artificial delay, renderer substitution or process
cancellation is used. Complete-state damage/protected gates run without tracing.

# Smallest contract tests: blank, malformed, and valid event streams.
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../tests/native/dcm-pdf-inflight.ps1')
function New-Event([string]$kind,[long]$seq,[long]$gen=5){
 return [pscustomobject]@{schema=1;host_pid=99;sequence=$seq;event=$kind;generation=$gen;renderer_pid=123;input_path='synthetic.pdf';output_path='synthetic.png';failed=$false;state=[pscustomobject]@{active=$false;busy=$false;pending=$false;worker_generation=0;generation=6;path=''}}
}
function New-Valid {return @((New-Event 'worker-started' 1),(New-Event 'selection-stopped' 2),(New-Event 'worker-finished' 3),(New-Event 'result-discarded' 4))}
$checks=0
function Reject($rows,[long]$new=0){$caught=$false;try{$null=Assert-DcmPdfInFlightTrace $rows 5 $false $new}catch{if(-not $_.Exception.Message.StartsWith('INFLIGHT_TRACE:')){throw};$caught=$true};if(-not $caught){throw 'Invalid lifecycle falsely accepted'};$script:checks++}
Reject @()
Reject @((New-Event 'worker-started' 1))
$r=New-Valid;$r[1].sequence=3;$r[2].sequence=2;Reject @($r|Sort-Object sequence)
$r=New-Valid;$r[3].host_pid=101;Reject $r
$r=New-Valid;$r[3].state.active=$true;Reject $r
$r=New-Valid;$r+=New-Event 'result-applied' 5;Reject $r
$r=New-Valid;$r[2].output_path='other.png';Reject $r
$null=Assert-DcmPdfInFlightTrace (New-Valid) 5 $false;$checks++
$r=New-Valid;$r[2].failed=$true;$r[3].failed=$true;$null=Assert-DcmPdfInFlightTrace $r 5 $true;$checks++

$r[4].state=[pscustomobject]@{active=$true;busy=$true;pending=$false;worker_generation=7;generation=7;path='synthetic.pdf'}
$null=Assert-DcmPdfInFlightTrace $r 5 $false 7;$checks++
$r[4].state.busy=$false;Reject $r 7
